minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, February 21st, 2024
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at 10:00 AM on Wednesday, February 21st, 2024.

  Members present: Terry Kistler, George Borst, Rafaela Giles, Jenny Jolly, Edward
  Padgett, Bette Donovan, and Scott Snider.

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Armando Cisneros, Community Services Specialist.

  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, January
  17th, 2023 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Lauren Torres, Visiting Angels: Lauren discussed all the benefits of
  having caregivers in the home and what they are available to do. They provide
  transportation to appointments: can fix meals; medication reminders, etc.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: Meals were served to an average of 28 participants per week
  in January.

  Meals on Wheels: 712 meals served to 45 La Verne recipients in January.

4. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through February 21st, 2024
  was $27.25. The average attendance for January/February was 52 players per
  week.

5. Account Balance: $6,308.46.

6. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for January. The senior program fee
  was raised to $1.00 at the beginning of the year.

7. MT. SAC Classes: Spring Session has begun.
 8. Aging Next: 15 La Verne residents were served in January.

  New Business

9. Facilities Report: Aquatic Center, bid approved. La Verne won the contest for
  Perk your Park and will receive $75,000. Still working on bids. The back of
  Senior Center has several leaks from recent rains.

10. Upcoming Events:

  - Wednesday, March 13th – Senior Seminar: Screening for Better Health, Presented by
  Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  - Thursday, March 14th – Excursion, The Getty Villa in Malibu, 8:30AM-3:30PM.
  - Saturday, March 23rd– Special Event, Egg-Cellent Adventure, Hertiage Park, 9:00AM-
  12:00PM.
  - Tuesday, March 26th – Excursion, Warner Bros. Studio Tour and Universal
  City Walk, 8:00AM-6:15PM.

11. Public Comments: George Borst announced Golf has about 25 players on their
  roster. Armando announced a new TriCity seminar for a plant group therapy and it
  was approved and seconded that the senior account pay for supplies. A therapist
  will offer some sessions on the 1st Thursday of the month starting this spring. The
  recreation guide will be out soon. Bette Donovan is working on starting a possible
  Bunko Group. Scott announced the Hillcrest Benevolent Fundraiser Drawing is
  3/15/24.

12. Adjourn: The meeting was adjourn at 11:00AM. Motion carried. The next
  meeting will be on Wednesday, March 20th, 2024 at 10:00AM.
